hints: Let dp[s] be the fewest coins needed to make sum s.
For each coin c<=s, try using c last after making s-c.
Use an unreachable sentinel and return -1 if x remains unreachable.
analogy: To make a total, consider which coin is the last one placed and add it to the best smaller total.
example: With coins 1,5,7 and x=11, dp[11] can use 5 after dp[6]=2, yielding three coins 5+5+1.
algorithm: Initialize dp[0]=0 and others to infinity. For each sum s, set dp[s]=min(dp[s-c]+1) for every coin c<=s.
correctness: Any coin collection for s has some final coin c; the rest make s-c, so choosing the best such predecessor gives the minimum.
